criteria.no: A required outcome rests on a subjective quality, an undefined label or mode, or an expected output, approval, or standard with no identified record.
criteria.unclear: An outcome is partly concrete, but what to inspect cannot be determined even though nothing is undefined or unrecorded.
criteria.yes: Every required outcome is a concrete behavior, output, file, path, value, tool use, or identified record that can be inspected.

observable.instructions: Can each outcome that `anchor.statement` requires be checked by inspecting something concrete: a behavior, output, exit status, file, path, value, tool used, or an identified record? Bundled duties, added details, and informal wording do not matter here. Nothing can be inspected for a subjective quality (robust), a label or mode the statement never defines (R7, Mode K), an expected output, approval, or standard whose record the statement does not identify, or a person's say-so with no identified record. A destination or location is concrete only when it is given as a path, URL, or other exact identifier; a tier, class, or category name the statement never defines (such as 'the gold-tier store') does not say where to look. A mode the statement defines inline is inspectable.

anchor.statement: When the caller passes --dry-run to the deploy command, the deploy command must not modify any file under /srv.
anchor.quote: if the caller passes --dry-run, deploy must not modify anything under /srv
